dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: "The one who may ascend is the one who <color=#00E1FFFF>kowtows atop the three mountains</color>. The sun, moon, and stars shall each shine, and auspicious signs shall be sent by the <color=#00E1FFFF>three divine birds</color>."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... It's a real headache trying to make sense of the adepti and all this other stuff in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must mean we have to find three shining birds on top of three mountains, right?
